notes: Iteration 3 repairs the two iteration-2 candidates whose mechanisms were confirmed but whose results were disqualified, and composes them. episodic_reset_v2 keeps the history reset and fixes the absorbing state that silenced 36 of 50 n=1 participants; primacy_v2 keeps the confirmed U-shaped retention and limits maintenance to MAX_KEYS-1 when chunks arrive in one simultaneous assistant message, which is where primacy's craft capability overshoot came from. episodic_primacy is a coordinator-written composition over disjoint method sets, contributing no new mechanism; it exists to measure whether the two repairs are additive, redundant or conflicting, and it asserts at import that BOTH are active so a silent fallback fails the run rather than mislabelling a result. No instrument rows this wave: all three run the full 8-task search set and none changes what a task measures.

repeat_baseline.purpose: Measure the real per-task run-to-run floor. metric_noise.py bootstraps by resampling the model side of a FIXED set of rows, so it captures sampling noise but not generation-level variation between runs, and the serving stack is NOT bit-deterministic -- two provable no-ops changed 7 and 12 of 150 craft rows' generated content. This is the same harness and config as iter0/baseline, so every per-task delta it shows is pure run-to-run variation.
quantities_requested: narrative_qa per-row score agreement and the resulting humanlikeness delta -- the only search-set cell whose scored noise is uncharacterised, and the cell on which three of four iteration-2 candidates were charged a floor violation, primacy's by 0.0009
craft_task five-rule-trial accuracy over the 50 overflowing rows, to confirm the observed 0.0000/0.0000 no-op band is not a two-observation accident
